summary: Public projects created on 16 August 2026: 3 repos.
intro: Three Claude Code agent plugins covered shopping, vehicle diagnostics and travel: Amazon marketplace research with verified listing and delivery data, OBD-II fault diagnosis and maintenance planning, and baggage allowance calculation with packing and excess pricing.

projects.name: Claude Amazon Plugin
projects.description: Claude Code plugin: Amazon.com marketplace research - verified listing data, Prime-aware delivery dates checked against the ZIP they were rendered for, and Amazon's search filter grammar.

projects.name: Claude OBD Diagnostics Plugin
projects.description: Claude Code plugin: read OBD-II data from an ELM327-class adapter, normalise it to JSON, and diagnose faults and plan maintenance from it. WIP.

projects.name: Claude Travel Packing Assistant Plugin
projects.description: Claude Code plugin: work out the real baggage allowance for every segment of an international itinerary, pack to the binding limit, price the excess options, and print an airport counter card
